The 67 pipeline registrations comprise 21 stages, 5 observers, 21 adapters, 19 test providers and 1 report adapter; the inventory separately records 2 OpenClaw extensions and 1 Codex plugin.

Bounded mutation fixtures explicitly distinguish their qualification from broader acceptance.

No actionable defect was established in these three obligations. Previously accepted plugin scopes remain preserved.
